column3: ekasmin samaye bhagavāṁllaṅkāpure tena khalu punaḥ samayena bhagavān anekaśakrabrahmanāgakanyākoṭibhiḥ pratyudgamyamāno yannvahamapi atraiva rāvaṇaṁ yakṣādhipatimadhikṛtya aśrauṣīdrāvaṇo rākṣasādhipatistathāgatādhiṣṭhānāt tanme syāddīrgharātramarthāya hitāya sukhāya devānāṁ atha rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipatiḥ saparivāraḥ pauṣpakaṁ upetya vimānādavatīrya saparivāro bhagavantaṁ cittasvabhāvanayadharmavidhiṁ nairātmyaṁ dṛṣṭivigataṁ pratyātmavedyagatisūcanakaṁ deśehi nāyaka iha ||
śubhadharmasaṁcitatanuṁ sugataṁ pratyātmavedyagatidharmarataṁ laṅkāṁ hi gantuṁ |
laṅkāmimāṁ pūrvajinādhyuṣitāṁ putraiśca teṣāṁ deśehi nātha iha dharmavaraṁ śroṣyanti yakṣa |
atha rāvaṇo laṅkādhipatiḥ toṭakavṛttenānugāyya punarapi sāgarendrasya bhavanāt samuttīrya taṭe sthitaḥ ||
ṛddhyā gatvā tamadhvānaṁ yatra tiṣṭhati nāyakaḥ |
anugṛhṇāhi me laṅkāṁ ye cāsmin puravāsinaḥ ||
śrotukāmā vayaṁ cādya ye ca laṅkānivāsinaḥ ||
anukampārthaṁ mahyaṁ vai yāhi laṅkāṁ sutaiḥ saha ||
ājñākaro.haṁ buddhānāṁ ye ca teṣāṁ jinātmajāḥ |
nāsti tadyanna deyaṁ me anukampa mahāmune ||
tatra gatvā purīṁ ramyāṁ punaḥ pūjāṁ pralabdhavān |
ahaṁ hi śrotā yakṣāśca jinaputrāśca sanniha |
adhyeṣayāmi tvāṁ bhaktyā nayaṁ pṛccha viśārada ||
atra tāḥ parṣadaḥ sarvā ekaikasmin hi dṛśyate |
sarvakṣetrāṇi tatraiva ye ca teṣu vināyakāḥ ||
cinteti kimidaṁ ko.yaṁ deśitaṁ kena vā śrutam |
kiṁ dṛṣṭaṁ kena vā dṛṣṭaṁ nagaro vā kva saugataḥ ||
tāni kṣetrāṇi te buddhā ratnaśobhāḥ kva saugatāḥ |
atha vā dharmatā hyeṣā dharmāṇāṁ cittagocare |
na draṣṭā na ca draṣṭavyaṁ na vācyo nāpi vācakaḥ |
ye paśyanti yathādṛṣṭaṁ na te paśyanti nāyakam ||
atha khalu mahāmatir bodhisattvo mahāsattvo utpādabhaṅgarahito lokaḥ khapuṣpasaṁnibhaḥ |
praśaṁsā yadi vā nindā tasyocyeta kathaṁ mune ||
viśuddham ā nimittena prajñayā kṛpayā ca te ||
na nirvāsi nirvāṇena nirvāṇaṁ tvayi saṁsthitam |
atha khalu mahāmatir bodhisattvo mahāsattvo mahāmatirahaṁ bhagavan mahāyānagatiṁ gataḥ |
tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā buddho lokavidāṁ varaḥ |
pṛcchantu māṁ jinasutāstvaṁ ca pṛccha mahāmate |
atha khalu mahāmatir bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavatā kathaṁ hi śudhyate tarkaḥ kasmāttarkaḥ pravartate |
kathaṁ hi dṛśyate bhrāntiḥ kasmādbhrāntiḥ pravartate ||
nirābhāsaḥ kramaḥ kena jinaputrāśca te kutaḥ ||
muktasya gamanaṁ kutra baddhaḥ kaḥ kena mucyate |
dhyāyināṁ viṣayaḥ ko.sau kathaṁ yānatrayaṁ bhavet ||
pratyaye jāyate kiṁ tatkāryaṁ kiṁ kāraṇaṁ ca kim |
nirbhidyettribhavaṁ ko.sau kiṁ sthānaṁ kā tanurbhavet |
sthitaḥ pravartate kutra jinaputraḥ kathaṁ bhavet ||
samādhyate kathaṁ cittaṁ brūhi me jinapuṁgava ||
lakṣaṇasya vyavasthānaṁ nairātmyaṁ ca kathaṁ bhavet ||
kathaṁ na vidyate sattvaḥ saṁvṛtyā deśanā katham |
kathaṁ hi tīrthikāstvaṁ ca lakṣaṇairna virudhyase |
śūnyatā ca kathaṁ kena kṣaṇabhaṅgaśca te katham |
kathaṁ pravartate garbhaḥ kathaṁ loko nirīhikaḥ ||
kathaṁ ca budhyase lokaṁ kathaṁ brūṣe nirakṣaram ||
nairātmyaṁ ca dvidhā kena kathaṁ jñeyaṁ viśudhyati ||
jñānaṁ katividhaṁ nātha śīlaṁ sattvākarāṇi ca |
kathaṁ yuktiḥ katividhā vyākhyānaṁ ca kathaṁvidham ||
annapānaṁ ca vaicitryaṁ maithunaṁ jāyate katham |
rājā ca cakravartī ca maṇḍalī ca kathaṁ bhavet ||
vidyāsthānaṁ bhavetkiṁ ca mokṣo yogī katividhaḥ |
prajñaptimātraṁ ca kathaṁ brūhi me vadatāṁ vara ||
ghanāḥ khe pavanaṁ kena smṛtirmeghaḥ kathaṁ bhavet |
taruvallyaḥ kathaṁ kena brūhi me tribhaveśvara ||
hayā gajā mṛgāḥ kena grahaṇaṁ yānti bāliśāḥ |
uhoḍimā narāḥ kena brūhi me cittasārathe ||
strīpuṁnapuṁsakānāṁ ca kathaṁ janma vadāhi me ||
kathaṁ caivaṁvidhā yoge narāḥ sthāpyā vadāhi me ||
gatyāgatānāṁ sattvānāṁ kiṁ liṅgaṁ kiṁ ca lakṣaṇam |
dhaneśvaraḥ kathaṁ kena brūhi me gaganopama ||
abhakṣyaṁ hi kathaṁ māṁsaṁ kathaṁ māṁsaṁ kravyādagotrasambhūtā māṁsaṁ bhakṣyanti kena vai ||
sarvaratnamayāḥ kṣetrāḥ kathaṁ kena vadāhi me ||
kena nirmāṇikā buddhāḥ kena buddhā vipākajāḥ |
tathatā jñānabuddhā vai kathaṁ kena vadāhi me ||
kāmadhātau kathaṁ kena na vibuddho vadāhi me |
vinayo bhikṣubhāvaśca kathaṁ kena vadāhi me ||
cittaṁ hi bhūmayaḥ sapta kathaṁ kena vadāhi me ||
cikitsāśāstraṁ sattvānāṁ kathaṁ kena vadāhi me ||
idaṁ śrutvā mahāvīro buddho lokavidāṁ varaḥ |
nirodhā ṛddhipādāśca bodhyaṅgā mārga eva ca |
svabhāvaḥ kalpanā kalpyaṁ dṛśyaṁ dṛṣṭidvayaṁ katham |
jñānaṁ jñeyo gamaṁ prāptiḥ sattvānāṁ ca bhavābhavam ||
hayā gajā mṛgāḥ kena grahaṇaṁ brūhi me katham |
kāryaṁ ca kāraṇaṁ kena nānābhrāntistathā nayam |
cittamātraṁ na dṛśyo.sti bhūmīnāṁ nāsti vai kramaḥ ||
acalānāṁ tathā meroḥ pramāṇaṁ hi kṣiteḥ katham |
kṣetre kṣetre rajāḥ kṛtto dhanvo dhanve bhavetkati ||
śaśavātāyanaṁ likṣā eḍakaṁ hi yavāḥ kati ||
prasthe hi syādyavāḥ kyantaḥ prasthārdhe ca yavāḥ kati |
droṇe khāryāṁ tathā lakṣāḥ koṭyo vai bimbarāḥ kati ||
sarṣape hyaṇavaḥ kyanto rakṣikā sarṣapāḥ kati |
karṣo hi dharaṇāḥ kyantaḥ palaṁ vai kati kārṣikā |
evaṁ hi pṛccha māṁ putra anyathā kiṁ nu pṛcchasi ||
katyaṇuko bhavetkāyaḥ kiṁ nu eva na pṛcchasi ||
vahneḥ śikhā katyaṇukā pavane hyaṇavaḥ kati |
indriye indriye kyanto romakūpe bhruvoḥ kati ||
gadyaṁ padyaṁ kathaṁ brūṣe maithunaṁ lokaviśrutā |
vajrasaṁhananāḥ kena hyacalā brūhi me katham |
ghanānāṁ saṁbhavaḥ kutra ṛtūnāṁ ca kuto bhavet |
śobhāśca jinaputrāśca kutra me pṛccha māṁ suta |
muktasya gamanaṁ kutra baddhaḥ kaḥ kena mucyate |
kathaṁ hi śudhyate tarkaḥ kena tarkaḥ pravartate ||
kriyā pravartate kena gamanaṁ brūhi me katham |
vidārya tribhavaṁ ko.sau kiṁ sthānaṁ kā tanurbhavet |
lakṣaṇaṁ pṛcchase kena nairātmyaṁ pṛcchase katham |
garbhā naiyāyikāḥ kena pṛcchase māṁ jinaurasāḥ ||
taruvallyaḥ kathaṁ kena pṛcchase māṁ jinaurasa |
vaṁśaḥ kaste guruḥ kena pṛcchase māṁ jinaurasa |
uhoḍimā narā yoge kāmadhātau na budhyase ||
siddhānto hyakaniṣṭheṣu yuktiṁ pṛcchasi me katham |
abhijñāṁ laukikāṁ kena kathaṁ bhikṣutvameva ca ||
nairmāṇikān vipākasthān buddhān pṛcchasi me katham |
cittaṁ hi bhūmayaḥ sapta pṛcchase māṁ jinaurasa |
etāṁścānyāṁśca subahūn praśnān pṛcchasi māṁ suta ||
siddhāntaṁ deśanāṁ vakṣye sahasā tvaṁ śṛṇohi me ||
upanyāsaṁ kariṣyāmi padānāṁ śṛṇu me suta |
atha khalu mahāmatir bodhisattvo mahāsattvo idaṁ tanmahāmate aṣṭottaraṁ padaśataṁ |
tatra sarvendriyavijñānanirodho mahāmate yaduta eṣa hi mahāmate lakṣaṇanirodhaḥ |

tatra yadāśrayam anādikālaprapañcadauṣṭhulyavāsanā tadyathā mahāmate mṛtparamāṇubhyo mṛtpiṇḍaḥ na cānyo yadi ca mahāmate mṛtpiṇḍo mṛtparamāṇubhyo.nyaḥ syāt sa cārabdhastairmṛtparamāṇubhiḥ tasmānnānyaḥ |
athānanyaḥ syāt mṛtpiṇḍaparamāṇvoḥ pratibhāgo na syāt |

evameva mahāmate athānanyāni pravṛttivijñānanirodhe ālayavijñānavirodhaḥ tasmānmahāmate na svajātilakṣaṇanirodho vijñānānāṁ kiṁ svajātilakṣaṇe punarnirudhyamāne ālayavijñānanirodhaḥ ālayavijñāne punarnirudhyamāne tīrthakarāṇāṁ mahāmate ayaṁ vādo yaduta vijñānaprabandhoparamād anādikālaprabandhavyucchittiḥ kāraṇataśca mahāmate tīrthakarāḥ prabandhapravṛttiṁ na cakṣurvijñānasya rūpālokasamudayata utpattiṁ kāraṇaṁ punarmahāmate punaraparaṁ mahāmate saptavidho bhāvasvabhāvo punaraparaṁ mahāmate saptavidhaḥ paramārtho yaduta etanmahāmate atītānāgatapratyutpannānāṁ tathā ca vyavasthāpayanti yathā kathaṁ ca mahāmate tīrthakaravādakudṛṣṭisādhāraṇā svacittadṛśyamātrānavatāreṇa mahāmate bālapṛthagjanā punaraparaṁ mahāmate ye kecinmahāmate śramaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā abhūtvā tatkasya hetoḥ yadidaṁ tadyathā mahāmate ghaṭakapālābhāvo ghaṭakṛtyaṁ na yadi punarmahāmate abhūtvā śraddhāvijñānānāṁ pratijñāhānir niyamanirodhaśca mahāmate prasajyate teṣāmapi mahāmate trisaṁgatipratyayakriyāyogenopadeśo evameva mahāmate bālapṛthagjanāḥ kudṛṣṭidaṣṭā ye punaranye mahāmate śramaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā mahākaruṇopāyakauśalyānābhogagatena mahāmate svacittanirābhāsamātrāvatāreṇa tasmāttarhi mahāmate bodhisattvair anādikālāprapañcadauṣṭhulyavikalpavāsanahetukaṁ tasmāttarhi mahāmate bodhisattvena mahāsattvena atha khalu bhagavān punareva mahāmatiṁ bodhisattvaṁ katamaiścaturbhiḥ yaduta ebhirmahāmate caturbhiḥ kāraṇairoghāntarajalasthānīyād yathā mahāmate cakṣurvijñāne evaṁ saha taireva mahāmate pañcabhirvijñānakāyair na ca teṣāṁ tasya caivaṁ bhavati vayamatrānyonyahetukāḥ atha ca anyonyābhinnalakṣaṇasahitāḥ pravartante tathā ca pravartamānāḥ pravartante yathā samāpannasyāpi yoginā caivaṁ bhavati nirodhya vijñānāni samāpatsyāmahe te cāniruddhaireva vijñānaiḥ samāpadyante evaṁ sūkṣmo mahāmate ālayavijñānagatipracāro anyatra kalyāṇamitrajinapuraskṛtairmahāmate śakyaṁ ata etasmāt kāraṇānmahāmate yoginā kalyāṇamitrajinayoge atha khalu bhagavāṁstasyāṁ velāyāmimā gāthā abhāṣata |
nīle rakte.tha lavaṇe śaṅkhe kṣīre ca śārkare |
na cānyena ca nānanyena taraṁgā hyudadhermatāḥ |
vijñānāni tathā sapta cittena saha saṁyutāḥ ||
ālayaṁ hi tathā citraṁ vijñānākhyaṁ pravartate ||
abhinnalakṣaṇā hyaṣṭau na lakṣyā na ca lakṣaṇam ||
vijñānānāṁ tathā cittaiḥ pariṇāmo na labhyate ||
cittena cīyate karma manasā ca vicīyate |
vṛttiśca varṇyate cittaṁ lakṣaṇārthaṁ hi bāliśān ||
na tasya vidyate vṛttiḥ svacittaṁ grāhyavarjitam |
grāhye sati hi vai grāhastaraṁgaiḥ saha sādhyate ||
ālayasya tathā vṛttiḥ kasmādbuddhyā na gamyate ||
tathā tvaṁ lokapradyota tattvaṁ deśesi bāliśān ||
bhāṣase yadi vā tattvaṁ citte tattvaṁ na vidyate ||
udadheryathā taraṁgā hi darpaṇe supine yathā |
pañcānāṁ khyāyate dṛśyaṁ kramo nāsti samāhite |
raṅge na vidyate citraṁ na bhūmau na ca bhājane |
vicitrā hi yathā māyā dṛśyate na ca vidyate |
buddhā hi tadvatsattvānāṁ cittamātraṁ vadanti vai ||

column5: tārkikāṇāmaviṣayaḥ śrāvakāṇāṁ na caiva hi |ye deśayanti vai nāthāḥ pratyātmagatigocaram ||

column3: punaraparaṁ mahāmate bodhisattvena prathamamadhyamapaścādrātrajāgarikāyogam anuyuktena kutīrthyaśāstrākhyāyikāśrāvakapratyekabuddhayānalakṣaṇsvacittadṛśyavikalpalakṣaṇagatiṁgatena ca bhavitavyaṁ |
yadi punarmahāmate vikalpo.nyaḥ athānanyaḥ syāt taddhetukatvād tadubhayabhāvābhāvātkasya kimapekṣya nāstitvaṁ anye punarmahāmate tīrthakaradṛṣṭayo ākāśameva ca mahāmate rūpam |
ādheyādhāravyavasthānabhāvena mahāmate bhūtāni mahāmate pravartamānāni na ca teṣvākāśaṁ nāsti |

evameva śaśasya viṣāṇaṁ mahāmate goviṣāṇamapekṣya goviṣāṇaṁ punarmahāmate aṇuśo vibhajyamānaṁ tasya kimapekṣya nāstitvaṁ bhavati athānyadapekṣya atha khalu bhagavān punarapi mahāmatiṁ bodhisattvaṁ svacittadṛśyavikalpānugamamanasā ca mahāmate sarvajinasutakṣetramaṇḍale ca tvayā atha khalu bhagavāṁstasyāṁ velāyāmimā gāthā abhāṣata |
dṛśyaṁ na vidyate cittaṁ cittaṁ dṛśyātpravartate |
aṇuśo bhajyamānaṁ hi naiva rūpaṁ vikalpayet |

column5: tārkikāṇāmaviṣayaṁ śrāvakāṇāṁ na caiva hi |yaṁ deśayanti vai nāthāḥ pratyātmagatigocaram ||

column3: atha khalu mahāmatirbodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ punarapi tadyathā mahāmate āmraphalāni kramaśaḥ pacyante na tadyathā mahāmate kumbhakāraḥ kramaśo bhāṇḍāni tadyathā mahāmate pṛthivyāṁ tadyathā mahāmate tadyathā mahāmate darpaṇāntargatāḥ sarvarūpāvabhāsāḥ tadyathā mahāmate somādityamaṇḍalaṁ tadyathā mahāmate ālayavijñānaṁ tadyathā mahāmate dharmatābuddho yugapan punaraparaṁ mahāmate dharmatāniṣyandabuddhaḥ punaraparaṁ mahāmate parikalpitasvabhāvavṛttilakṣaṇaṁ tadyathā vastuparikalpalakṣaṇābhiniveśavāsanātparikalpayan eṣā mahāmate niṣyandabuddhadeśanā |
dharmatābuddhaḥ punarmahāmate nirmitanirmāṇabuddhaḥ punarmahāmate tīrthyadṛṣṭyā ca rūpyasamatikramaṇalakṣaṇaṁ deśayati |
ālambavigataṁ tasmāttarhi mahāmate pratyātmāryagativiśeṣalakṣaṇe svacittalakṣaṇadṛśyavinivṛttidṛṣṭinā ca te bhavitavyam |

punaraparaṁ mahāmate dvividhaṁ tatra mahāmate pratyātmāryādhigamaviśeṣalakṣaṇaṁ skandhadhātvāyatanasvasāmānyalakṣaṇabāhyārthavināśalasvacittaṁ samādhāya etanmahāmate śrāvakāṇāṁ pratyātmāryagatilakṣaṇam |
etaddhi mahāmate śrāvakāṇāṁ etanmahāmate śrāvakāṇāṁ bhāvavikalpasvabhāvābhiniveśaḥ punarmahāmate etanmahāmate bodhisattvenādhigamya vyāvartayitavyam |

dharmanairātmyalakṣaṇānupraveśatayā etanmahāmate śrāvakāṇāṁ atha khalu mahāmatirbodhisattvo mahāsattvo nanu bhagavaṁstīrthakarā api nityācintyavādinaḥ tatkasya hetoḥ tīrthakarāṇāṁ mahāmate nityācintyaṁ na yasya mahāmate nityācintyaṁ na hetusvalakṣaṇayuktam mama tu mahāmate paramārthanityācintyaṁ ata etanmahāmate tīrthakaranityācintyavādatulyaṁ na nityācintyataiveyaṁ mahāmate tathāgatānāṁ tasmāttarhi mahāmate bodhisattvena mahāsattvena punaraparaṁ mahāmate nityācintyatā tīrthakarāṇām na svakṛtahetulakṣaṇaprabhāvitatvānnityam |

yadi punarmahāmate tīrthakarāṇāṁ nityācintyatā yadi punarmahāmate hetulakṣaṇasaṁyuktaṁ nityācintyatā tatkasya hetoḥ yaduta vāgvikalpamātraṁ hi mahāmate mama tu mahāmate nityācintyatā yasya punarmahāmate bāhyābhāvān pratyātmādhigamāryajñānagocaralakṣaṇaṁ bahirdhā te punaraparaṁ mahāmate saṁsāravikalpaduḥkhabhayabhītā saṁsāranirvāṇayoraviśeṣajñāḥ sarvabhāvavikalpābhāvād ataste mahāmate mohapuruṣā yānatrayavādino bhavanti na ataste mahāmate atītānāgatapratyutpannānāṁ te saṁsāragaticakre punarmahāmate caṅkramyante |
punaraparaṁ mahāmate anutpannān sarvadharmān tatkasya hetoḥ yaduta svacittadṛśyabhāvābhāvāt sadasator śaśahayakharoṣṭraviṣāṇatulyā mahāmate sarvadharmāḥ |
bālapṛthagjanābhūtaparikalpitasvabhāvavikalpitatvān pratyātmāryajñānagatigocaro hi mahāmate dehabhogapratiṣṭhāgatisvabhāvalakṣaṇaṁ mahāmate atra te mahāmate yogaḥ karaṇīyaḥ |
katamāni pañca yaduta śrāvakayānābhisamayagotraṁ kathaṁ punarmahāmate śrāvakayānābhisamayagotraṁ lakṣaṇaparicayajñāne cāsya buddhiḥ praskandati na idaṁ mahāmate śrāvakayānābhisamayagotram |
yaḥ śrāvakayānābhisamayaṁ dṛṣṭvā ṣaṭpañcamyāṁ anye punarmahāmate anye punarmahāmate kāraṇādhīnān sarvadharmān dṛṣṭvā dharmanairātmyadarśanābhāvānnāsti mokṣo mahāmate |
eṣā mahāmate atra te mahāmate kudṛṣṭivyāvṛttyarthaṁ yogaḥ karaṇīyaḥ |

tatra mahāmate pratyekabuddhayānābhisamayagotrakaḥ asaṁsargapratyayād etanmahāmate pratyekabuddhayānābhisamayagotrakasya tatra mahāmate tathāgatayānābhisamayagotraṁ trividham yadā punarmahāmate trayāṇāmapyeṣāmanyatame etanmahāmate tathāgatayānābhisamayagotrakasya aniyatagotrakaḥ punarmahāmate triṣvapyeteṣu parikarmabhūmiriyaṁ mahāmate gotravyavasthā |
pratyātmālaye tu svakleśavāsanāśuddhasya atha khalu bhagavāṁstasyāṁ velāyāmimā gāthā abhāṣata |

tatrecchantikānāṁ punarmahāmate anicchantikatāmokṣaṁ tatra sarvakuśalamūlotsargaḥ katamaḥ yaduta dvitīyaḥ punarmahāmate bodhisattvo mahāsattva evaṁ etanmahāmate aparinirvāṇadharmakāṇāṁ lakṣaṇaṁ punarapi mahāmatirāha katamo.tra bhagavan atyantato na na punaḥ sarvakuśalamūlotsargecchantikaḥ |

sarvakuśalamūlotsargecchantiko hi mahāmate punarapi tatkasya hetoḥ yaduta aparityaktā hi mahāmate ata etasmātkāraṇānmahāmate bodhisattvecchantiko na punaraparaṁ mahāmate bodhisattvena mahāsattvena tatra mahāmate parikalpitasvabhāvo nimittātpravartate |

kathaṁ punarmahāmate parikalpitasvabhāvo tatra mahāmate vastunimittalakṣaṇābhiniveśaḥ parikalpitasvabhāvaṁ vyavasthāpayanti tathāgatā arhantaḥ tatra vastunimittābhiniveśalakṣaṇaṁ punarmahāmate nimittalakṣaṇābhiniveśaḥ punar yaduta teṣveva etanmahāmate dviprakāraṁ parikalpitasvabhāvasya yadāśrayālambanāt pravartate tatparatantram |
tatra mahāmate pariniṣpannasvabhāvaḥ katamaḥ yaduta eṣa mahāmate pariniṣpannasvabhāvas atha khalu bhagavāṁstasyāṁ velāyāmimāṁ nimittaṁ nāma saṁkalpaḥ svabhāvadvayalakṣaṇam |

eṣa mahāmate pañcadharmasvabhāvalakṣaṇapravicayo punaraparaṁ mahāmate bodhisattvena mahāsattvena tatra mahāmate katamannairātmyadvayalakṣaṇam yaduta nadībījadīpavāyumeghasadṛśakṣaṇaparamparābhedabhinnyadatra mahāmate lakṣaṇakauśalajñānam idamucyate tatra mahāmate dharmanairātmyajñānaṁ katamat yaduta yathā mahāmate skandhadhātvāyatanānyātmavirahitāni cittamanomanovijñānapañcadharmasvabhāvarahitān dharmanairātmyakuśalaḥ punarmahāmate bodhisattvo bhūmilakṣaṇapravicayāvabodhāt pramuditānantaram sa tasyāṁ pratiṣṭhito.nekaratnamuktopaśobhite buddhasutabhūmim atikramya etanmahāmate sarvadharmanairātmyalakṣaṇam |
atra te mahāmate śikṣitavyam anyaiśca atha khalu mahāmatirbodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ punarapi abhisaṁbudhya atha khalu bhagavān punarapi mahāmaterbodhisattvasya samāropāpavādo hi cittamātre na vidyate |
atha khalu bhagavānetameva gāthārthamuddyotayan katamaścaturvidhaḥ yaduta asallakṣaṇasamāropo eṣa hi mahāmate caturvidhaḥ samāropaḥ |
apavādaḥ punarmahāmate katamaḥ yaduta asyaiva etaddhi mahāmate samāropāpavādasya lakṣaṇam |
punaraparaṁ mahāmate asallakṣaṇasamāropasya lakṣaṇaṁ etaddhi mahāmate asallakṣaṇasamāropasya lakṣaṇam |
eṣa hi mahāmate asallakṣaṇasamāropavikalpo etaddhi mahāmate asallakṣaṇasamāropasya lakṣaṇam |
asaddṛṣṭisamāropaḥ punarmahāmate yasteṣveva ayamucyate mahāmate asaddṛṣṭisamāropaḥ |
asaddhetusamāropaḥ punarmahāmate yaduta pravṛtya bhūtvā ca punarvinaśyati |
asadbhāvasamāropaḥ punarmahāmate yaduta ete ca mahāmate bhāvābhāvavinivṛttāḥ |

śaśahayakharoṣṭraviṣāṇakeśoṇḍukaprakhyā mahāmate samāropāpavādāśca bālairvikalpyante etanmahāmate asadbhāvavikalpasamāropāpavādasya tasmāttarhi mahāmate samāropāpavādadṛṣṭivigatena punaraparaṁ mahāmate bodhisattvāś parikalpitasvabhāvā iva paratantrāśayā yāvadanekāni samādhikoṭīniyutaśatasahasrāṇi pratilabhya buddhapūjābhiyuktāśca sarvopapattidevabhavanālayeṣu atha khalu bhagavāṁstasyāṁ velāyāmimāṁ cittamātraṁ yadā lokaṁ prapaśyanti jinātmajāḥ |
atha khalu mahāmatirbodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ punarapi atha khalu bhagavān mahāmatiṁ bodhisattvaṁ bhāṣiṣye.haṁ te |
sādhu bhagavanniti mahāmatirbodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavānetadavocat śūnyatā śūnyateti mahāmate parikalpitasvabhāvābhiniveśena punarmahāmate tatra mahāmate saṁkṣepeṇa saptavidhā śūnyatā |
yaduta lakṣaṇaśūnyatā bhāvasvabhāvaśūnyatā tatra mahāmate lakṣaṇaśūnyatā katamā yaduta parasparasamūhāpekṣitatvāt pravicayavibhāgābhāvān svaparobhayābhāvācca mahāmate lakṣaṇaṁ nāvatiṣṭhate |
bhāvasvabhāvaśūnyatā punarmahāmate katamā yaduta tenocyate bhāvasvabhāvaśūnyateti |
apracaritaśūnyatā punarmahāmate katamā yaduta tenocyate apracaritaśūnyateti |
pracaritaśūnyatā punarmahāmate katamā yaduta skandhā tenocyate pracaritaśūnyateti |
itaretaraśūnyatā punarmahāmate katamā yaduta yadyatra tadyathā mahāmate śṛgālamātuḥ prāsāde aśūnyaṁ ca bhikṣubhiriti bhāṣitaṁ mayā |
na ca punarmahāmate prāsādaḥ prāsādabhāvato nāsti na ca te.nyatra hastigavaiḍakādyā bhāvā nāvatiṣṭhante |
na svayamutpadyate na ca punarmahāmate te notpadyante tenocyante anutpannā niḥsvabhāvāḥ |
anutpattiṁ saṁdhāya mahāmate niḥsvabhāvāḥ kṣaṇasaṁtatiprabandhābhāvācca tenocyate niḥsvabhāvāḥ sarvabhāvā iti |
advayalakṣaṇaṁ punarmahāmate katamat yaduta evaṁ saṁsāranirvāṇavanmahāmate sarvadharmā advayāḥ na yatra mahāmate nirvāṇaṁ tatra saṁsāraḥ |
na ca yatra saṁsārastatra nirvāṇam vilakṣaṇahetusadbhāvāt tenocyate advayāḥ saṁsāraparinirvāṇavat sarvadharmā iti |
tasmāttarhi mahāmate atha khalu bhagavāṁstasyāṁ velāyāmime gāthe abhāṣata |
saṁsāraṁ svapnamāyākhyaṁ na ca karma vinaśyati ||
atha khalu bhagavāṁstasyāṁ velāyāmimāṁ pudgalaḥ saṁtatiḥ skandhāḥ pratyayā aṇavastathā |

atha khalu mahāmatirbodhisattvo.nāgatāṁ janatāṁ bhagavānāha caturbhirmahāmate dharmaiḥ samanvāgatā katamaiścaturbhiḥ yaduta svacittadṛśyavibhāvanatayā ca ebhirmahāmate caturbhirdharmaiḥ samanvāgatā tatra kathaṁ mahāmate bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ evaṁ hi mahāmate bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ kathaṁ punarmahāmate bodhisattvo mahāsattva svacittamātrānusāritvād bāhyabhāvābhāvadarśanād aṣṭamyāṁ bhūmau sthitāś mahāmatirāha manomayakāya iti bhagavan kena kāraṇena tadyathā mahāmate mano.pratihataṁ evaṁ hi mahāmate bodhisattvo mahāsattva tatra kathaṁ mahāmate bodhisattvo mahāsattvo anādikālaprapañcadauṣṭhulyavicitravipākavikalpavāsanābebhirmahāmate caturbhirdharmaiḥ samanvāgatā atra te mahāmate yogaḥ karaṇīyaḥ |
atha khalu mahāmatirbodhisattvaḥ punarapi bhagavānāha dviprakāraṁ mahāmate tatra bāhyapratītyasamutpādo mahāmate |

mṛtpiṇḍadaṇḍacakrasūtrodakapuruṣaprayatnādipratyayair yathā ca mahāmate ghaṭo mṛtpiṇḍādeva tantubhyaḥ paṭāḥ tatra ādhyātmikaḥ pratītyasamutpādo yaduta avidyā tṛṣṇā ebhya utpannā mahāmate skandhadhātvāyatanākhyā te cāviśiṣṭāḥ kalpyante ca bālaiḥ |

yaduta bhaviṣyaddhetuḥ saṁbandhaheturlakṣaṇahetuḥ tatra bhaviṣyaddheturmahāmate hetukṛtyaṁ saṁbandhahetuḥ punarmahāmate ālambanakṛtyaṁ lakṣaṇahetuḥ punaraparaṁ mahāmate kāraṇahetuḥ punarmahāmate ādhipatyādhikārakṛtyaṁ vyañjanahetuḥ punarmahāmate utpannasya vikalpasya upekṣāhetuḥ punarmahāmate vinivṛttikāle ete hi mahāmate svavikalpakalpitā bālapṛthagjanairna tat kasya hetoḥ yadi punarmahāmate yugapatpravarteran atha kramavṛttyā pravarteran alabdhasya ajātaputrapitṛśabdavan mahāmate tārkikāṇāṁ hetvārambaṇanirantarādhipatipratyayādibhir parikalpitasvabhāvābhiniveśalakṣaṇānmahāmate yugapan svacittadṛśyadehabhogapraviṣṭhānatvāt anyatra svacittadṛśyavikalpavikalpitatvād vijñānaṁ tasmāttarhi mahāmate tatredam ucyate |
yatra bālā vikalpanti pratyayaiḥ sa nivāryate ||
tadā grāhaśca grāhyaṁ ca bhrāntiṁ dṛṣṭvā nivartate ||
na cotpādya na cotpannaḥ pratyayo.pi na kiṁcana |
atha khalu mahāmatirbodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ punarapi bhagavānāha tena hi mahāmate śṛṇu sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca bhāṣiṣye.haṁ te |

sādhu bhagavan iti mahāmatirbodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavānasyaitadavocat caturvidhaṁ mahāmate yaduta lakṣaṇavāk svapnavāk tatra mahāmate lakṣaṇavāk svapnavāk punarmahāmate dauṣṭhulyavikalpābhiniveśavāk punarmahāmate anādikālavikalpavāk punarmahāmate etaddhi mahāmate caturvidhaṁ vāgvikalpalakṣaṇamiti me atha khalu mahāmatirbodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ punarapi kutra kasmāt kathaṁ kena bhagavan nṛṇāṁ mahāmatirāha kiṁ punarbhagavan vāg vikalpādanyā uta tatkasya hetoḥ yaduta taddhetūtpattilakṣaṇatvānmahāmate yadi punarmahāmate vāg vikalpādanyā syāt athānanyā syāt arthābhivyaktitvād vāṅ na kuryāt |
punarapi mahāmatirāha kiṁ punarbhagavan vacanameva tatkasya hetoḥ yaduta paramārthastu mahāmate āryajñānapratyātmagatigamyo na tena vikalpo nodbhāvayati paramārtham |

vacanaṁ punarmahāmate utpannapradhvaṁsi capalaṁ yacca mahāmate parasparapratyayahetusamutpannaṁ svaparalakṣaṇābhāvānmahāmate bāhyalakṣaṇaṁ punaraparaṁ mahāmate svacittadṛśyamātrānusāritvād tasmāttarhi mahāmate vāgvicitrā vikalparahitena te tatredamucyate |
bhavaṁ parīkṣeta na saṁsāre nāpi nirvāyāt ||
pralobhya krīḍayitvā ca bhūtān dadyāttato mṛgān ||

punaraparaṁ mahāmate na ca mahāmate yadi punarmahāmate yoginām evaṁgativiṣayāṇāṁ yā punareva mahāmate deśanā punarmahāmate bālāśayagatadṛṣṭipravṛttā na ca tadyathā mahāmate jalāntargatā vṛkṣacchāyā khyāyate |

sā ca na chāyā nāchāyā vṛkṣasaṁsthānāsaṁsthānataḥ tadyathā mahāmate darpaṇāntargatāni atha ca te mahāmate svacittadṛśyavikalpāḥ khyāyante evameva mahāmate svacittapratibimbāni khyāyante tadyathā mahāmate pratiśrutkā sā ca na bhāvā nābhāvā ghoṣāghoṣaśravaṇataḥ evameva tadyathā mahāmate nistṛṇagulmalatāvanāyāṁ medinyām te ca na bhāvā nābhāvā lobhyālobhyataḥ |
evameva mahāmate bālānām tadyathā mahāmate vetālayantrapuruṣau niḥsattvau tatra ca asadvikalpe bālā abhiniviśante gamanāgamanataḥ |
evameva mahāmate bālapṛthagjanāḥ sa ca asadbhūtasamāropaḥ |
mṛgā gṛhṇanti pānīyaṁ na cāsyāṁ vastu vidyate ||
bālā gṛhṇanti jāyantaṁ timiraṁ taimirā yathā ||
bālaḥ kīle yathā kīlaṁ pralobhya vinivartayet ||
cittaṁ keśoṇḍukaṁ māyā svapnaṁ gandharvameva ca |
alātaṁ mṛgatṛṣṇā ca asantaḥ khyāti vai nṛṇām ||
darpaṇe udake netre bhāṇḍeṣu ca maṇīṣu ca |
bimbaṁ hi dṛśyate teṣu bimbaṁ nāsti ca kutracid ||
bhāvābhāsaṁ tathā cittaṁ mṛgatṛṣṇā yathā nabhe |

punaraparaṁ mahāmate catuṣṭayavinirmuktā tathāgatānāṁ asatyapratītyasamutpādanirodhamārgavimokṣapravṛttipūrna prakṛtīśvarahetuyadṛcchāṇukālasvabhāvopanibaddhā punaraparaṁ mahāmate punaraparaṁ mahāmate caturvidhaṁ dhyānam |

katamaccaturvidham yaduta bālopacārikaṁ dhyānam tatra mahāmate bālopacārikaṁ dhyānaṁ katamat yaduta tatra arthapravicayadhyānaṁ punarmahāmate katamat tatra tathatālambanaṁ dhyānaṁ mahāmate katamat yaduta tāthāgataṁ punarmahāmate dhyānaṁ katamat yaduta tatredam ucyate |
nimittāni ca citrāṇi tīrthamārgaṁ nayanti te |
śiro hi tasya mārjanti nimittaṁ tathatānugam ||

atha khalu mahāmatirbodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ punarapi kasyaitadbhagavannadhivacanaṁ yaduta nirvāṇamiti punaraparaṁ mahāmate nirvāṇam kathaṁ na śāśvatam yaduta tatrānucchedo yaduta sarvārthā atītānāgatapratyutpannāḥ punarmahāmate mahāparinirvāṇaṁ na nāśo na maraṇam |
yadi punarmahāmate mahāparinirvāṇaṁ maraṇaṁ syāt atha vināśaḥ syāt saṁskṛtalakṣaṇapatitaṁ syāt |
ata etasmātkāraṇānmahāmate mahāparinirvāṇaṁ na nāśaṁ cyutivigataṁ maraṇamadhigacchanti yoginaḥ |
punaraparaṁ mahāmate mahāparinirvāṇam punaraparaṁ mahāmate śrāvakapratyekabuddhānāṁ viṣayāviparyāsadarśanād vikalpo na pravartate |

punar aparaṁ mahāmate dviprakāraṁ katamat dviprakāram yaduta tatra mahāmate abhilāpasvabhāvābhiniveśo tatra vastusvabhāvābhiniveśaḥ punar mahāmate punaraparaṁ mahāmate adhiṣṭhānadvayādhiṣṭhitā katamenādhiṣṭhānadvayenādhiṣṭhitāḥ yaduta tatra mahāmate bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ prathamāyāṁ samanantarasamāpannānāṁ ca teṣāṁ bodhisattvānāṁ yathā mahāmate vajragarbhasya bodhisattvasya kalpaśatasahasraṁ saṁcitaiḥ kuśalamūlairanupūrveṇa sa ca bodhisattvaste ca bodhisattvāḥ etanmahāmate bodhisattvānāṁ mahāsattvānām anyatrāvyavalokyāstathāgatā arhantaḥ punaraparaṁ mahāmate yatkiṁcid bodhisattvānāṁ yadi punarmahāmate bodhisattvānāṁ mahāsattvānām tatkasya hetoḥ yaduta adhiṣṭhānānadhiṣṭhitatvāt |
tṛṇagulmavṛkṣaparvatā api mahāmate vividhāni ca kiṁ punarmahāmate sacetanā mūkāndhabadhirā api evaṁ mahāguṇaviśeṣaṁ mahāmate tathāgatādhiṣṭhānam ||
punaraparaṁ mahāmatirāha kiṁ etena mahāmate kāraṇena tathāgatā arhantaḥ anadhiṣṭhitāśca mahāmate bodhisattvā mahāsattvāḥ atastena kāraṇena bodhisattvā |
